steps.name: 1,2-dichloro-1,2-dihydro-3H-1λ3-benzo[d][1,2]iodazol-3-one S-2
steps.procedure: Procedure I (Alt): {R:NCS} (4.80 g, 36 mmol, 1.2 equiv.) was added to a solution of {R:2-iodobenzamide S-1} (7.41 g, 30 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) in 50 mL {S:MeCN}. The reaction mixture was heated to {T:60 °C} and stirred for {H:6 h} under nitrogen. Upon cooling, the precipitate was collected by filtration and washed with cold MeCN (2 × 20 mL) and diethyl ether (2 × 15 mL) to afford {P:1,2-dichloro-1,2-dihydro-3H-1λ3-benzo[d][1,2]iodazol-3-one S-2} (8.3 g) in {Y:88%} yield as an off-white solid.

steps.name: CFBI
steps.procedure: Procedure II (Alt): S-2 (2 g, 6.4 mmol, 1.0 equiv.) was dissolved in anhydrous {S:DMF} (32 mL) under argon. {R:KF} (1.86 g, 32 mmol, 5.0 equiv.) and {R:18-crown-6} (0.85 g, 3.2 mmol, 0.5 equiv.) were added. The mixture was heated to {T:80 °C} and stirred for {H:18 h}. The reaction was quenched with water (50 mL), extracted with EtOAc (3 × 40 mL), dried over MgSO4, and concentrated. Purification by column chromatography (hexanes/EtOAc 4:1) gave {P:CFBI} as a white solid in {Y:55%} yield.
